title: Extended Japanese Commonsense Morality Dataset with Masked Token and Label Enhancement

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models' moral judgment performance on a subset of sentences requiring an understanding of Japan-specific culture, customs, and laws (e.g., returning sand from a baseball game, legal drinking age), to highlight the bias in LLMs trained primarily on Western-centric data and values.

Comparing the classification performance (Accuracy and F1 scores) of LLMs predominantly trained on English datasets (like GPT-4 Turbo) against models fine-tuned specifically on an expanded Japanese morality dataset (eJCM).
